PRESS 5/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Shoulders
SECONDARY
Triceps, Core

Instructions

Preparation: Establish a stable wall-supported handstand before starting. Place both palms firmly on the floor and keep heels supported. Keep your neck neutral and control the descent.

1

Straight arms; keep heels against the wall.

2

Brace your torso; keep legs together.

3

Bend elbows; lower under control.

4

Touch lightly; keep support through your palms.

5

Press through both palms to straight arms.

6

Reset with head neutral and heels supported.

Watch out

Press through both palms; keep control as your crown approaches the floor.

COMMON MISTAKES

Dropping onto your head.
Losing torso control or kicking to press.
Letting the hands slide.
